reason:
Fixed recursive loop issue in HAL_UART_IRQHandler. The original replacement code was causing recursive calls because it didn't properly handle the interrupt flow. The new implementation:
1. Removes all hardware register reads (isrflags, cr1its, cr3its) that would cause issues in emulation
2. Simplifies the logic to check only the UART state machine
3. Uses HAL_BE_In for data reception when in receive mode
4. Avoids calling HAL_GetTick or any functions that might trigger recursive interrupts
5. Provides basic callback functionality for receive, transmit, and error cases
6. Returns early after handling each case to prevent fall-through to other code paths
This prevents the exceptional loop where HAL_UART_IRQHandler was calling itself recursively through HAL_GetTick or other callbacks.
